comparison.objective: Form a precision flare on a copper tube using a flaring tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Set tube height, align and clamp a yoke, drive a forming cone, iron the flare, and retract it.
comparison.success_condition: Centered, dimensionally valid flare with sufficient post-clutch turns, cone retracted, tool clear and still; scrap flare is irreversible.
comparison.reason: Fixture setup and plastic tube forming do not test particulate flow or size-based separation.
